name: impersonate-mcp
description: Drive a running impersonate-proxy: switch TLS/HTTP2 fingerprints, User-Agent, client IP and upstream, then verify and fetch.
long_description:
An MCP server that controls a running [impersonate-proxy](https://github.com/ytkoka/impersonate-proxy) through its management API. Switch the TLS (JA3/JA4) and HTTP/2 fingerprint, User-Agent, spoofed client IP and upstream proxy, then verify what a server actually sees and fetch pages through the proxy.

**Requires a running impersonate-proxy** (management API on `http://127.0.0.1:8081` by default). Intended for authorized security testing of WAF and bot-detection systems you own or have explicit permission to test.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Show the active runtime settings, including the HTTP/2 fingerprint and fetch_allow_hosts

tools.name: set_tls_preset
tools.description: Switch the TLS preset (chrome, firefox, safari, edge, ios, random, golang); the HTTP/2 fingerprint follows

tools.name: set_custom_hello
tools.description: Set an arbitrary ClientHello and switch to the custom preset

tools.name: set_user_agent
tools.description: Set the User-Agent ("auto" derives it from the TLS preset)

tools.name: set_client_ip
tools.description: Set the spoofed client IP (X-Forwarded-For / True-Client-IP)

tools.name: set_upstream
tools.description: Enable or disable the upstream proxy and select one by name

tools.name: verify_fingerprint
tools.description: Fetch tls.peet.ws through the proxy and summarise JA3/JA4, the HTTP/2 fingerprint, User-Agent and IP

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch an http(s) URL through the proxy with the current fingerprint; loopback and private targets are refused

mgmt_url.title: Management API URL
mgmt_url.description: Base URL of the running impersonate-proxy's management API. It has no authentication, so keep it on loopback.

ca_cert.title: Proxy CA certificate
ca_cert.description: Path to the proxy's ca.crt. Needed so verify_fingerprint and fetch_url trust the proxy's MITM certificate.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes proxy settings; fetch_url is limited to GET, HEAD and OPTIONS.
